title: The Roc and the Diamond Valley
logline: Left behind asleep on a wooded island, Sinbad finds the egg of the giant roc, ties his turban to the bird's leg and is carried to a valley floored with diamonds and guarded by snakes, where falling meat and a strong eagle give him the way out.
moral: A cool head and a gentle hand find a way out of the deepest valley; wonders are for sharing.
tone: Bright adventure with wonder and light comedy; the giants (roc, snakes, eagle) are calm animals minding their own business and the tension comes from scale and from Sinbad keeping very quiet. Family friendly throughout.

beats.summary: After a long stay in Baghdad Sinbad goes back to sea.
On a wooded island he rests under a tree and sleep takes him.
He wakes alone: the ship has sailed without noticing he is missing.
From a lookout tree he sees an enormous white dome in the middle of the silent island.
The dome is an egg: the egg of the roc.
The sky darkens under a wing.
The roc lands by its nest, wings like two clouds.
He ties his turban to the bird's leg, gently, without hurting it.
The roc flies and carries him over the mountains.
It lands in a distant valley.
High cliffs all round and huge snakes among the rocks.
A big piece of meat falls from the top of the mountain.
An eagle carries another piece up to its nest: there is the way out.
He ties himself to the meat.
A strong eagle lifts it, and him, up the whole cliff.
He unties himself and tiptoes away from the nest.
The waiting traders are amazed that he is alive; he shares his diamonds.
He sails for Baghdad carrying a wondrous tale.

subtitles.ar: عاد السندباد إلى البحر بعد إقامة طويلة في بغداد.|وفي يوم جميل، نزل مع التجار إلى جزيرة مشجرة.|استراح تحت شجرة، وغلبه النوم.
subtitles.en: After a long stay in Baghdad, Sinbad returned to sea.|One fine day, he went ashore with the traders on a wooded island.|He rested under a tree and fell asleep.

subtitles.ar: حين استيقظ، لم يجد أحدًا حوله، فقد أبحرت السفينة من غير أن يلاحظ غيابه.|بحث عن طريق للنجاة، فرأى قبة بيضاء هائلة وسط الجزيرة الصامتة.
subtitles.en: When he awoke, nobody was there: the ship had sailed without noticing his absence.|Searching for a way to survive, he saw an enormous white dome in the silent island’s center.

subtitles.ar: اقترب السندباد من القبة، فعرف أنها بيضة طائر عظيم يسمى الرخ.|وبعد قليل أظلمت السماء، وهبط الطائر قرب عشه،|وكان جناحاه كالسحابتين.
subtitles.en: Sinbad approached the dome and realized it was the egg of a giant bird called the roc.|Soon the sky darkened. The bird landed by its nest,|its wings like clouds.

subtitles.ar: فكر السندباد بسرعة، وربط عمامته بإحدى رجلي الطائر من غير أن يؤذيه.|وحين طار الرخ،|حمله فوق الجبال، ثم هبط به في وادٍ بعيد.
subtitles.en: Sinbad thought quickly and tied his turban to one of the bird’s legs without hurting it.|When the roc flew,|it carried him over the mountains and landed in a distant valley.

subtitles.ar: حل السندباد الرباط، ونظر حوله.|كانت الأرض تلمع بأحجار الألماس، لكن الصخور العالية تحيط بالوادي، وبينها حيات كبيرة.|جمع بعض الأحجار وبحث عن مخرج آمن.
subtitles.en: Sinbad untied the cloth and looked around.|Diamonds glittered on the ground, but high cliffs surrounded the valley, with huge snakes among the rocks.|He collected a few stones and searched for a safe way out.

subtitles.ar: فجأة سقطت قطعة لحم كبيرة من أعلى الجبل.|لاحظ السندباد أحجارًا تلتصق بها،|ثم رأى نسرًا يحمل قطعة أخرى إلى عشه قرب القمة العالية.
subtitles.en: Suddenly a large piece of meat fell from above.|Sinbad noticed diamonds sticking to it,|then saw an eagle carrying another piece to its nest near the mountaintop.

subtitles.ar: أسرع السندباد، وربط نفسه بقطعة اللحم فوق الأحجار اللامعة.|حملها نسر قوي إلى الأعلى، ولما وضعها قرب عشه،|فك السندباد الحبل وابتعد بهدوء.
subtitles.en: Sinbad hurried to tie himself to a piece of meat above the shining stones.|A strong eagle carried it upward. When it placed the meat near its nest,|Sinbad untied himself and moved away quietly.

subtitles.ar: رآه تجار ينتظرون النسور، فدهشوا من نجاته.|أعطاهم بعض الألماس،|فساعدوه على ركوب سفينة إلى بغداد، حاملًا قصة عجيبة.
subtitles.en: Traders waiting for the eagles saw him and marveled at his escape.|He gave them some diamonds,|and they helped him board a ship to Baghdad with a wondrous tale.

new_assets.name: roc
new_assets.description: Gigantic gentle bird, side view, feet at (x, y), facing dir. At s 1: standing height 1150, body ellipse 900 x 560 centred at (0, -620), neck to a head of radius 150 at (430, -980), beak 220 long with a rounded hook, eye radius 34; thigh feather trousers to y -330, bare shank 90 thick from y -330 to y -40, foot with three front toes 200 long and 60 thick, one back toe 120, blunt claws 50; each wing 1500 long with a scalloped trailing edge of 9 round lobes in three colour bands; five tail streamers 500 long. Fields: s, dir, rot, spread 0..1, flap -1..1, crouch 0..1, sit 0..1 (brooding: body 260 lower, shanks folded), neck, headTurn, beak, lid, gaze, breathe, shake, legsOnly (shanks, feet and a belly feather band, for close shots), silhouette (flat lilac or any colour), plus the shared acting fields. Returns anchors: ankle (near leg), eye, wing tips. Reusable for any roc, simurgh, phoenix or giant bird.
new_assets.implementation: Each part is a closed polygon filled with celShade (hard lilac shade, coloured outline): body ellipse, neck quad strip, head circle, beak as two polygons, wing as a fan of 9 lobes whose angles interpolate between a folded and a spread key by spread and are offset by flap with the tip lobes delayed (lagged), tail streamers as ribbons on a travelling sine. Legs are the Library two bone IK (seg) from hip to a planted foot target so walking and landing never slide. Pose channels on celStep(t, 12); lid on celStep(t, 8). Draw order for the nest: far wing, far leg, body, rocEgg, belly feather band over the egg top, near leg, near wing. For the eclipse and far shots use silhouette with a halation edge.

new_assets.name: diamondValley
new_assets.description: Tall valley strip with the floor, both walls, ledges, the nest ledge, the shelf, the rim terrace (valleyRim view) and the skyFlight mountain layers. All coordinates are in sets. Reusable for any gorge, pit, mountain climb or cliff nest (follows the planned rockyHill conventions).
new_assets.implementation: Bake three plates once: far wall and sky (soft gradients), the climb wall bands (polygons with a jagged right or left edge from K.noise, hard shade strips under each ledge, a few cracks and tufts), and the floor (sand gradient plus about 120 gems from the diamonds scatter helper). Boulders, ledges in front of actors and the rim grass are flat cels with front passes. Live parts: 14 seeded glints on threes, lightBands across the floor, far eagles. The camera is one group translate and scale on t. The rim view is the same draw with the world shifted 2300 down and its own dressing. The skyFlight layers are three tileable ridge polygons drawn twice and slid by t.

new_assets.name: woodedIsland and rocNest
new_assets.description: The wooded variant of the SIND-01 islandShore (beach, glade with shade tree, brook, lookout tree, far dome) in two light models, and the nest clearing with its log ring. Coordinates in sets.
new_assets.implementation: Forest wall as three baked canopy bands of overlapping circles in six greens with fruit dots, trunks as tapered quads, undergrowth props seeded (ferns, mushrooms as in ALI-01, flowers, stones); the shade tree and lookout tree are cel groups with front passes; light discs and shadows are separate shapes moved between the morning and afternoon models. The nest ring is 12 log quads with end rings and twig lines, split into back and front passes. The shadow plate for 46.3 to 50.7 is a second bake of the same shapes with a cooler palette, revealed through a wing polygon mask that slides on t.

new_assets.name: snake
new_assets.description: Planned name (KD-005): a snake whose body follows any path, here at giant scale (70 thick, about 900 long) with a diamond pattern option and three palettes. Fields used: path, out 0..1, wave, rear 0..1, coil 0..1, tongue, mouth, lid, gaze.
new_assets.implementation: Sample the path every 12 units, offset each point along its normal by a travelling sine (wave), and stroke it three times: dark outline width 78, body colour width 70, belly line width 14 offset down; pattern = diamonds stamped every 60 units of arc length along the path normal frame; head = rounded polygon at the path end with two eyes (eye2) and a tongue line pair. The coil is a path that is a 2.5 turn spiral of outer radius 110.

new_assets.name: rocEgg, giantFeather, meatSlab, diamonds, turbanCloth, sashPouch
new_assets.description: Six props; rocEgg, giantFeather and jewels (diamond) reuse planned names. Sizes and states are in props.
new_assets.implementation: rocEgg: one ellipse polygon with celShade and a specular patch, rotated by wobble about its buried base. giantFeather: a leaf polygon with three colour bands clipped to it and a quill line, bent by curl. meatSlab: rounded polygon with an inner rim strip, bone as a capsule plus knob, wobble as a 2 cycle damped shear. diamonds: 6 point polygon with 5 facet triangles; glint from the style. turbanCloth: a polyline ribbon (width 14) whose points come from a small state function (helix for unwind and rewind, catenary between two points for hands and tied, fixed offsets on the torso for sling, strap and scarf), with a travelling sine on free ends and separate back and front passes where it goes round the ankle or the slab. sashPouch: a small knot polygon with halation.

new_assets.name: carried and strapped (person hanging from a line, person strapped to a prop)
new_assets.description: Sinbad hanging under the roc on the cloth (both hands on the line above his head, legs dangling with a lagged swing) and strapped to the front of the meat slab (drawn inside the slab transform, lying when the slab is flat and upright when it hangs).
new_assets.implementation: No new drawing: person with handLW and handRW on the line point, walk amp 0 and a small leg offset from swing(t, t0, amp); for the strap, draw person inside the same ctx transform as meatSlab so one rot value turns both, with the turbanCloth strap bands drawn over him.

owner_questions: The ending adds a picture the script does not narrate: a far roc crosses the sun and one giant feather falls to Sinbad on the homeward deck under THE END (default: keep it, as the echo of the far whale that closes SIND-01).
The roc is drawn as a calm white mother bird with cloud wings, a crimson crest and blunt claws, and it never notices Sinbad; no attack, no chase (default: keep this gentle reading).
The snakes are huge but sleepy: they look, yawn and flick their tongues and never strike or chase (default: keep; the danger is told by Sinbad tiptoeing).

The meat is a friendly cartoon joint with a bone, with no blood or detail, and the traders are seen throwing it from the rim before the narration explains them in the last paragraph (default: keep both).

Sinbad uses his own turban cloth as the rope in paragraph 7 and wears it as a sling in between, so he is bare headed with black hair from 57.3 to 138.4 and rewinds the turban on the way home (default: yes; the tangerine sash keeps his accent on him).

Invented English lettering: HELLO?..., THE SHIP!, A WHITE DOME?, TOK TOK, AN EGG!, THE ROC, WHUMP!, WINGS LIKE CLOUDS, EASY, BIG BIRD..., SINBAD, DIAMONDS!, SSSS..., THUD!, STICKY!, AHA!, TIP... TOE..., FROM THE VALLEY?! (default: keep all 17 plus the title, LATER... and THE END).

Small additions for life and humour: the cat taking his cushion in Baghdad, the monkey stealing his fruit, the merchant who counts a sack as Sinbad, the melon sized diamond he puts back, the eaglet that notices him (default: keep).

The ship that leaves him is the series dhow with the SIND-01 captain at the helm (the miscount is shown as the merchants' mistake), and the ship home is the same drawing with emerald stripes (default: as described).

The sky darkening at 46.3 is shown as a wing shaped shadow with a repainted cooler plate inside it and the sun covered by the wing, not as night and not as a tint over the characters (default: as described, following the owner direction for this style).
implementation_notes: Style cel-anime-80s, owner direction first (Library/styles/cel-anime-80s/look.md): frame with S.background(ctx, W, H, t, THEME.page) and S.box(ctx, 54, 54, 972, 1196, 1, THEME.panel); per frame: sky plate, far layers, cels, front passes, light (glows, lightBands, castFinish rim), lettering, S.finish last.

Copy from Animations/SIND-01/src once it exists, under the same names: the SINBAD pal constant and cast settings, dhow and skiff, the openSea kit (seaY, seaClip, splash, plates day and gold), harbourQuay ('baghdad', 'island'), islandShore, the spyglass inset clip circle. Do not redraw them; add only the 'wooded' variant, the mountain port plate colours and the dhow stripe option.

Characters on twos: tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) for every pose channel (flow(tc, KEYS), idleSway(tc, ...), walk(xf, tc)); blinks, lids, tongue flicks, glints and lip flaps on celStep(t, 8). Camera, layer slides, light bands, the shadow mask and the CRT pass use t.

No tint over the cast in any scene. The shadow of the roc (46.3 to 50.7) is a second plate through a mask plus castFinish(ctx, x, y, w, h, draw, {rim:'#7ad9ff', light:[1,-1]}); the diamond glow at 133.94 is a halation shape plus a white rim; the gold afternoon in S22 is the SIND-01 gold plate.

Scale is the story. Keep these ratios: Sinbad 230 high; egg 760 high above the nest; roc 1150 standing; roc shank 90 thick; snake 70 thick; eagle at s 2.2. In the 0.42 and 0.36 wides Sinbad is about 90 px: keep his tangerine visible and use the SINBAD arrow tag at 65.2.

Camera scale and translate values per scene are in each scene's camera notes; all are one group transform about a ground point so the ground never floats. S7 pull-out: scale 1.0 to 0.42 about (900, 900) from 47.96 to 49.0. S11: world slides up 1400. S16 and S18: world slides down 1980 between the floor (y 900) and the nest ledge (y -1080). S20 uses the rim view (world shifted 2300).

turbanCloth timeline: on the head to 57.3; unwind 57.3 to 58.3; hands 58.3 to 59.16; tied to the ankle 60.0 to 73.46 (taut from 64.56 to 69.9); sling 73.46 to 110.76; hands 110.76 to 111.68; strap 111.68 to 124.0; scarf 124.86 to 138.42; rewind 138.42 to 139.6; turban (rot 8 degrees) after. Sinbad's head is head:'hair' with pal.hair '#2a2030' whenever the cloth is off his head; check on a still that the pal override takes, otherwise draw the hair cap in the scene.

Roc states: silhouette crossing the sun 47.28; descent spread 1 with braking flaps 47.96; impact 48.94; sit 0 to 1 from 50.08; spread 1 at 50.68 to 52.5 then 0; lid 1 by 54.0; cut-in eye 62.36 to 63.0; sit to 0 at 63.08; crouch 64.1; take off 64.56; flap period 1.6 s in S10; glide from 67.72; land 69.68; leaves at 75.3. In S8 draw it with legsOnly plus the belly band.

The eagle is the Library hawk: bird(ctx, {kind:'hawk', pal:1, s:2.2, fly, flap, grip, carry: (c) => drawSlabWithSinbad(c), swing}); carry takes a function, so the slab and the strapped Sinbad hang from the grip point in one transform.

Speech and tags: balloons with S.label(ctx, text, x, y, p, {balloon:true, to:[x, y]}) for HELLO?... (20.1), EASY, BIG BIRD... (61.3) and FROM THE VALLEY?! (131.9); the rest are plain S.label tags, with S.arrow where the action names one; THE ROC and DIAMONDS! use the chrome label; WHUMP! is the word of the S.emphasis impact frame at 48.94; THUD! at 93.6 is a plain label with a 2 frame flash. Lettering total 20 including the title, LATER... and THE END; never over a face.
Title: S.title with THE ROC AND / THE DIAMOND VALLEY from 0.3 to 3.4 and the Arabic line from story.json title_ar in Lalezar ({font:'Lalezar'}) under it.

Transition: one S.transition(..., {rect: panel, caption:'LATER...'}) from 16.6 to 17.5, inside the pause, with the morning to afternoon light swap at 17.05. Every other change of place is a cut on a phrase boundary.

Sound: 8 effects, master 0.6, each inside a listed pause or after the last word: glitch 16.9, riser 35.2, thud 54.3, blip 71.3, whoosh 92.0, chime 109.3, blip 127.6, chime 143.6. Nothing on the landing at 48.94 or the THUD! at 93.58: both are under words.

Moving holds everywhere (Guide section 15): idleSway on tip and head, breathe on sq, ribbons (turban tail, sash end, cloth ends, roc streamers) with lagged, groups with stagger(i) and per member seeds, groundShadow under every hop, landing, lift off and falling object. The roc always breathes; the snakes always carry a slow wave.
THE END appears at 143.7 and holds to 147.82 (end_hold 4.0) over the moving sea, ship, cast and the far roc.
Subtitles: keep chunks_ar.txt, chunks_en.txt and timing.json as they are; the subtitles field here is a verbatim copy.

Run the alive checklist on contact sheets of: the wake up and the run (17.7 to 25.9), the landing of the roc (46.3 to 54.0), the tying (57.3 to 63.0), the flight (64.5 to 71.9), the snakes (83.8 to 86.5), the lift (116.5 to 123.3) and the traders (128.1 to 136.9).
warnings: The roc is the main risk: build it first and check it on stills at s 1 (legs and belly only), 0.42 and 0.36 before any acting. It must read as huge and kind.
The vertical valley needs two long camera travels (S16, S18); far layers of Library strips only do horizontal parallax, so the valley is its own module with a vertical translate.
Sinbad is small in the wides at 0.42 and 0.36 scale; the tangerine cloth and one arrow tag carry him. Check phone legibility on stills.
Sinbad lying strapped to the slab uses the front facing lie pose rotated with the slab; check the 90 to 0 degree turn at 118.2 on every second frame.
Only seven pauses: 8 short effects, all under 0.5 s; the LATER transition must fit 16.6 to 17.5.
This plan assumes the SIND-01 source exists when animation starts; if it does not, build dhow, openSea, harbourQuay and islandShore from the SIND-01 plan first.

New modules are above the usual four (roc, diamondValley with skyFlight and rim, woodedIsland with rocNest, snake, six props) because the story visits four new places; all are reusable and three reuse planned names.
